issues.description: source() checks Path.home()/Download/percona-server-8.4.10_10.tar.gz before downloading the official URL. The sha256 check prevents content substitution, so this is non-blocking, but always using the declared source URL would be more reproducible.
issues.fix_suggestion: Optional: remove the local staged source fallback or replace it with a standard Conan cache/source mirror mechanism.

summary: W4 independent audit passed for percona-server/8.4.10_10 after the current RPC/tirpc fix. The patch no longer modifies extra/tirpc/CMakeLists.txt or any bundled generated configure script; OHOS client-only builds skip MYSQL_CHECK_RPC instead. Patch metadata includes patch_type portability and a numbered patch_description. No P0/P1 issues remain. The test_package links the package target and calls mysql_library_init, mysql_get_client_info, mysql_get_client_version, and mysql_thread_safe, so it is not an empty shell. The public archive contains no private endpoint, username, port, key path, or remote user path. Current remote conan create and target test_package execution passed for package reference percona-server/8.4.10_10#0367aef34d81dbe7fc9bb0d58363ea2d:b32e95946afda220db8287f449b037f206c3d8ff#d8c734ff432db966e415c7cbc960b39b; validation wording remains limited to build/package/consumer-link/target-execution and explicitly excludes PR CI, merge, and publication.
